thread:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding the new GPU fleet in us-west-2 ran into TargetRegistrationRateExceeded when the autoscaling groups attach targets to our internal NLBs.
maria: Yikes. Do you have logs / an AWS case yet?
alex: Yup opened a case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?region=us-west-2#/case/1234567890. Error snippet from kube-provisioner:
```
ERROR registering target: TargetRegistrationRateExceeded: Rate exceeds limit
	status code: 400, request id: abcdef12-3456-7890
```
jordan: How many nodes are we trying to register and over what window?
alex: Spinning 1,200 new g5 instances across 3 AZs. Bootstrap attaches happen in waves — we see bursts where ~200 registrations/min/AZ hit the NLB->VPCE path and throttle.
samir: Common pattern. AWS has per-VPCE and per-target-group registration throttles. Short-term mitigations: stagger registration, add jitter in userdata, split into more target groups or separate NLBs, or use IP target mode if feasible.
alex: We already added exponential backoff in the attach script but autoscale bursts still create concurrent attempts. Cold-start rollout next week will be worse.
maria: What do we ask AWS for in the quota bump? Exact numbers please.
alex: Proposed ask in ticket: increase NLB target registration rate to 2,000 registrations/min per account/region and raise interface VPC endpoint target limits to 5,000 per VPCE in us-west-2 for acct 999-888-777. Also ask for higher concurrent registration operations per TargetGroup (from default 350/min to 1,500/min). Mention this is for GPU fleet onboarding and will be phased.
jordan: I'll escalate to our TAM and request pre-warm. In parallel we should implement these quick fixes:
- Split instances into 6 smaller TGs (spread AZs)
- Add 20-60s random jitter before attach in userdata
- Pause parallel ASG scaling during rollout
- Create a separate NLB per 400 nodes if quota doesn't move
ops-bot: :warning: deployment-pipeline: rollout paused for gpu-fleet/us-west-2 due to backend errors (PR #4102)
alex: Plan: pause the rollout, apply jitter + split TGs, and ask AWS to escalate with the numbers above. Target re-open window: Tuesday 02:00 UTC. I'll paste AWS case updates here.
maria: +1. Please include cost impact in the AWS escalation: delayed onboarding = ~$12k/week in deferred savings from spot commitments.
aws-support: Thanks for the details, we've attached the request to case 1234567890 and assigned to escalation team. We'll update once we have pre-warm confirmation.
alex: Thanks — will follow up after TAM ping. If anyone has other mitigations (IP mode caveats, LB limits doc links) drop them here.
samir: Also consider rolling with smaller lifecycle hooks so ASG doesn't try to register before instance is fully healthy. That reduced spikes for the last warmup by ~60%.
maria: Good call. I'll coordinate the maintenance window announcement once the new plan is set.
